verdict.rationale: Teller is an API-first product. Its server-to-server REST endpoints use certificate-based mTLS authentication (machine credentials, no interactive login), and its sandbox uses simulated data with deterministic MFA codes such as OTP '0000', which suits automated testing. A community user's export script shows the API can be scripted. However, account enrollment runs through the user-facing Teller Connect component, and nothing documents CI or headless use. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless enrollment path, CI/automation guidance, an OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
